entry.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
entry.note: Credentials against the AI management system standard the compliance section tracks
entry.audience: AI management system implementers and auditors

covers: regulatory and ethical considerations of AI implementation
aligning AI initiatives with core business objectives
developing and implementing an AI management system
evaluating quality, reliability and performance of AI systems
ensuring AI solutions meet standards and function as intended
identifying AI related risks and mitigation measures
reading.summary: This is a set of PECB training courses based on ISO/IEC 42001, the standard that sets out requirements and guidance for establishing, implementing, maintaining and continually improving an AI management system (AIMS) in an organization. The courses are intended to build the competencies needed to plan, develop, implement, maintain and improve such a system. A PECB ISO/IEC 42001 certificate shows the holder can understand regulatory and ethical issues around AI, help align AI initiatives with business objectives, support the development and implementation of an AIMS, assess the quality, reliability and performance of AI systems, identify AI related risks and put mitigation measures in place.
reading.audience: The page says the courses are for individuals seeking proficiency in artificial intelligence management systems and for those who want to plan, develop, implement, maintain and improve an AI management system within organizations.
